method: CC-SAM D3: Selective Many-to-Tail Margin Guard

stage2.sampling: exact sealed official CC-SAM plan; per-epoch hashes must equal D1

selective_margin_guard.eligible_inputs: true label is Many and matching frozen D0 teacher Many-to-non-Many margin > epsilon
selective_margin_guard.teacher: matching same-dataset same-seed D0 final epoch-30 classifier; frozen
selective_margin_guard.logits: student and teacher logits on clean cached TRAIN features

evaluation.official_test_access: only in the separate evaluate phase after all six D3 jobs and provenance checks

decision_gates.many_improves_over_d1: positive paired mean and positive in at least 2/3 seeds on each dataset
decision_gates.few_gain_over_d0: positive in at least 2/3 seeds on each dataset
decision_gates.many_recovery_over_d2: positive paired mean on each dataset
decision_gates.overall_floor: D3-D0 paired mean >= -0.2 percentage points on each dataset
decision_gates.guard_activation: eligible and active guard examples must be nonzero separately on ImageNet-LT and Places-LT; report per-dataset rates

stop_conditions: any baseline checkpoint, feature cache, manifest, or sampling-plan hash mismatch
any teacher or encoder/BN state change
any nonfinite loss, gradient, or parameter
any official TEST access before the evaluate phase
